## Estimated pet progression

Pets with a missing starting level now show an estimated counter from zero instead of staying Unknown. Observed pickups advance through 0/5, Lv.1 at 5, Lv.2 after another 25, and Lv.3 after another 75 souls.

Estimated ranks and progress bars are labeled on pet cards, the map and minimap. Estimates follow observed pickups across reader sessions. Existing retained pickup counts seed the estimate; ambiguous login soul counters are not treated as lifetime totals.

Confirmed login levels, live rank-up events and verified in-game cards replace estimates. Estimated maximum ranks do not count as confirmed completion or hide a farming target. Existing confirmed ranks, settings, pins and routes are preserved.
